evidence_quotes.O: What a charming, quirky, insanely cool cover for me Kindle! The second I saw this retro cover, I ordered it.
evidence_quotes.C: I felt that I owed this company and any viewers a solid update on this Kindle case, after putting it through some SERIOUS use the past 30 days.
evidence_quotes.E: Now, for the review. I LOVE THIS FRICKIN' THING!!!!
evidence_quotes.A: THANK YOU, Sony, for continuing to fulfil a true need for so many people (young and old) who need something that is simple to use
evidence_quotes.N: The Good: The colour is a lovely deep shrimp and I was delighted with the slight, subtle embossing of a flower on the front cover.
